title: Have you paid for all the services you need for the NFL yet? | OutKick

facts.fact: The article was published on September 10, 2026 at 3:02 PM Eastern Time.
Netflix will carry five NFL matchups this season, including games on Thanksgiving Eve, Christmas Day and in Week 18.
facts.quote: The streaming service will carry five matchups this season, including games on Thanksgiving Eve, Christmas Day and in Week 18.

facts.fact: Because of Netflix's schedule, fans need Netflix subscriptions in four of the season's five months (September, November, December and January), and Netflix carries no game in October.
facts.quote: fans will need subscriptions in September, November, December and January — four of the season's five months. Netflix will not carry a game in October.

facts.fact: A monthly Netflix subscription costs between $8.99 and $26.99, depending on the plan.
facts.quote: A monthly Netflix subscription costs between $8.99 and $26.99, depending on the plan.

facts.fact: Amazon Prime costs $14.99 per month and fans need it for five months, from Week 2 through the Wild Card Round.
facts.quote: Fans will again need Amazon Prime for five months, from Week 2 through the Wild Card Round, at $14.99 per month.

facts.fact: YouTube TV's Sports Plan costs $64.99 per month and includes local channels, ESPN, TNT, TBS, FS1, Big Ten Network and SEC Network.
facts.quote: YouTube now offers a $64.99-per-month Sports Plan that includes local channels, ESPN, TNT, TBS, FS1, Big Ten Network, SEC Network and more.

facts.fact: New YouTube TV Sports Plan users can subscribe for $49.99 per month during their first six months.
facts.quote: New users can subscribe for $49.99 per month during their first six months.

facts.fact: A bundle of Fox One and ESPN Unlimited costs $39.99 per month and provides access to games on Fox, ESPN and ABC.
facts.quote: They can bundle Fox One and ESPN Unlimited for $39.99 per month, providing access to games on Fox, ESPN and ABC.

facts.fact: Paramount+ costs an additional $8.99 per month for CBS games.
facts.quote: Paramount+ costs an additional $8.99 per month for CBS games

facts.fact: Peacock costs $12.99 per month for NBC games.
facts.quote: Peacock costs $12.99 per month for the games on NBC.

facts.fact: The article estimates fans will spend at least $450 to $500 to watch all the nationally televised games this season.
facts.quote: fans are looking at spending at least $450 to $500 to watch all the nationally televised games this season.

facts.fact: NFL Sunday Ticket on YouTube costs $336 for the year, or $240 for new subscribers.
facts.quote: The package costs $336 for the year, or $240 for new subscribers.

facts.fact: Memes suggest watching the NFL this season will cost roughly $800; the article cites this as a meme claim, not its own figure.
facts.quote: That is the context behind the memes suggesting it will cost roughly $800 to watch the NFL this season.
